# P&L Check

> P&L Check — open-source протокол: факты → сверка прибыли и денег → бриф для решения. Без угадывания, без шаблонных советов. Apache-2.0.

## Documentation
- [README](./README.md): RU hero, quick start, battle test example, JSON-LD
- [SKILL.md](./skills/pnl-check/SKILL.md): Full skill — 10 indicators, 5 evidence levels, safety rails
- [Battle test](./examples/pnl-discovery-economy-2026-09-14.md): Real run on Discovery economy
- [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [Templates](./templates/): context_questionnaire, pnl_structure.csv, data_gap_report
